title: Seriously Clear Sour Tropical Burst 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Seriously Clear Sour Tropical Burst is a high-impact exotic medley that provides a sharp, fruity kick. The profile features a vibrant mix of mixed Tropical Fruits, creating a sweet and juicy foundation reminiscent of a classic fruit punch. This is immediately transformed by a punchy, sour edge that sharpens the tropical sweetness and delivers a highly refreshing finish. The double-concentrated recipe ensures this tangy tropical blend remains consistently intense. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter kits. The premium nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a highly effective option for everyday use. For the best performance and clear flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm. The Seriously Clear collection by the acclaimed UK mixologists at Doozy Vape Co. and Crystal Clear offers a premium range of double-concentrated "bar salt" e-liquids. Designed to provide maximum flavour intensity with a remarkably clean finish, this line focuses on sharp, vibrant fruit and sour profiles. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, this e-liquid is available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, providing a versatile and satisfying choice for your refillable device. Crafted for convenience, this liquid works with vape refillable and starter kits .
